text.p: German utility Bayerwerk said on Wednesday that it planned to split its activities in the energy market into profit centres during 1998.
The Viag subsidiary's power production, distribution, power sales and marketing divisions are set to each become independent profit centres, management board chairman Otto Majewski said in a speech.

One holding company would focus on common objectives and developing new areas. The holding company would also deal with the central coordination of network load, electricity production, sales and distribution.
In the production sector, the group's activities will be divided into three units -- hydroelectric power, nuclear energy and conventional thermal power stations.
